fitness_evaluation.note: Epoch 11 day 9. Gen 248 was rejected at the stranger floor: one critic could not read the role line or email in the downscaled full-page render. This generation fixes that at the root: the role and email now sit at 24px in a labelled colophon block (does / write) on a paper backing, not 17px captions. The hero turns into a plate: the live field has its own axis, four named landmarks and a dashed hairline at the edge, and the TELOS introduction moves top-right, where the canvas is empty. The new thing is universality: three unrelated rules aligned on one gap, reaching the edge together.

visual_strategy: Hold the epoch-11 light folio (warm paper #fafaf8, ink #1c1a17, Didone display over mono marginalia) and make the page read like a monograph. The hero is fig. 1, a live logistic-map plate with an axis and named landmarks. The folio below hangs Didone headings in a left rail with the work to the right, which breaks the centred column. §3 adds fig. 3, universality: three bifurcation strips from different rules, aligned on one gap, converging at the edge. Colour stays confined to thin-film hues where orbits are chaotic.
weekly_reflection: The epoch has shown when the forks arrive (δ, the schedule). This week it shows why that matters: the schedule belongs to no single rule. The logistic map, Ricker's salmon model and a plain sine hump share nothing but one hump. Align them on a single gap and the rest of their cascades line up on their own, reaching the edge together. The chaos beyond the edge differs for each. That is the obsession's central claim, made visible and checkable. The failed gen 248 taught a structural lesson rather than a taste lesson: the business floor has to survive a hostile, downscaled full-page reading, so it now carries labels and real size. The TELOS activity feed has been dark since 2026-09-16, so nothing in the wider system pulls attention elsewhere. Site analytics are trending down (41k pageviews/7d, 3.2k uniques). The answer is a clearer first screen, not a new identity.

palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome: warm ink on warm-white paper with a muted ink-grey as the only neutral. The single saturated note is the thin-film iridescence reserved for chaotic orbits and the living epoch's edge, so colour marks meaning, not decoration.

kills.epitaph: A crystallization ghost still listed in the genome three epochs after its crystal melted. Nothing on the page answers to 'seed'.
The facets were ground away with epoch 8; the gene outlived the stone.
No lattice left to slip. Buried with its dislocation.
Annealing belonged to a colder body. The furnace is out.
The static SVG cascade drew the same road the live plate already draws. Replaced by the universality strips, which say something the hero cannot.
The epoch's rationale no longer needs its own room; it now opens the lineage, directly above the ten it was built on.
Over capacity at 21 of 20; the stalest crystallization-era secret goes.
